user.title: Add Kodak Camera
user.description: Enter the local IP address of your Kodak Smart Camera. Make sure Home Assistant and the camera are on the same network.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to refresh the camera state (10–300 seconds)

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the camera. Check the IP address and that the camera is online.
error.timeout: Connection timed out. Is the camera on the same network?
error.not_kodak_camera: The device responded but does not appear to be a Kodak Smart Camera.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

init.title: KodaxHA Settings
init.description: Update stream URLs and poll interval. Leave URL fields blank if not yet known.

data_description.stream_url: e.g. rtsp://192.168.178.36:554/ — used for live video and Homebridge
data_description.snapshot_url: e.g. http://192.168.178.36/snapshot.jpg — used for still images
